wrong.why: The Hebrew identifies the sender as Zedekiah king of Judah, represented by mattaniah, rather than zedekiah, the prophet who made iron horns.

note: The chapter does not distinguish the two Shaphan records; owner row 106793 identifies Elasah’s father as shaphan. Owner row 105826 is retained, although this chapter does not state Jehoiada’s descent from Aaron.
